# Ten Pi workers with inference on host-a

The live 100latent sandbox pilot launched ten independently authenticated
Pi 1.5.2 coding workers from Git commit
`2f9f55b9ab09d6094b25d9a9f48f4d9d49e7e4c2`. Four ran on host-a (x86-64),
three on host-e (arm64), and three on host-f (arm64). Every accepted episode
used the `model-under-test` API alias on host-a's local vLLM service.
The worker process checked filesystem and child-process restrictions and
denial of a TCP port outside the model allowlist. Controller credentials
stayed outside the agent's filesystem scope.

The controller launched ten worker processes in parallel. The estimated
peak was seven overlapping Pi sessions, measured from prompt timestamps
and transcript writes.

The ten initial tasks targeted eight repository paths. Two pairs each
independently created the same routing module. Four workers edited
disjoint files, and two additional proposals were used for handoffs.
Independent readback matched every GitHub proposal's tree and sole parent
to its local Lit export.

The broker first observed PRs #446 and #447 in the native queue. It revoked
their claims, denied both stale publication and stale registration from
each old worker, and closed the old PRs. A new Pi session on host-a took
over the host-f task. A new Pi session on host-f took over the host-e task.
Both replacements used host-a for inference and passed their local checks.
[PR #446](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/446) · [PR #447](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/447) · [PR #449](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/449) · [PR #450](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/450)

Git independently reproduced both add/add conflicts after the first
contribution landed for each shared module. The broker retired the two
held attempts and rejected their stale writes. Pi on host-e and host-f
recreated the held changes on fresh pins using host-a inference. Both
repairs added the missing function while preserving the entire syntax
tree of the first function. The repaired modules passed all 21 local
acceptance checks. [PR #451](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/451) · [PR #452](https://github.com/100latent/lit-merge-queue-sandbox/pull/452)

All 14 accepted proposal heads passed their native PR checks. Ten PRs
merged and four retired PRs closed without merging. The independent audit
matched each integration to its exact Git parents, merge event, and
successful GitHub Actions App 15368 check. The audit found zero manual
statuses on the merged heads or merge commits. `git fsck --full --strict`
and 55 acceptance checks passed across the eight final files at
`44417d32877fc5dbd937eb348fbf6b80b4fd986f`.

The queue's build concurrency temporarily rose from one to ten after
the handoffs. The Actions-only rule required a single-entry merge and
allowed zero bypass actors throughout. The original rules were restored.
All ten temporary worker identities were rejected after revocation, and
the broker retained all fourteen proposal records across the cleanup
restart. The 144 broker regressions passed on macOS and each worker host.

One generated patch contained a top-level statement that the fixture
verifier rejected. Pi regenerated it successfully using host-a inference.
Post-MIT upstream remained black-box. Raw transcripts are retained
outside the repository.
